title: Finance Import Notification Fix
description: Always send Telegram notification after CSV import. Previously only fired when imported > 0, so all-skipped imports (already up to date) were silent. Now sends distinct messages for new imports vs up-to-date.
author: Ka'tuar'el + Claude
changes: Removed `imported > 0` condition — notification fires on every CSV import
New import message: ✅ Finance Import Complete (shows new + skipped counts)
Up-to-date message: ℹ️ Finance Import — Up to Date (shows skipped count)
rollback: Revert to previous mythos_patch_monitor.py from git
